subject: unexpected behavior when simulating values from dmulti

messages.author: bed9858844040a0b
messages.subject: unexpected behavior when simulating values from dmulti
parts:
Attached is a script and an R workspace containing data objects necessary to run the script. When I try to define the model in the script, I get the following error:

Error in genVarInfo3() : Dimension of n.pred is 0, which does not match its usage in 'n.pred.SqEr[d] <- pow(n.pred[d] - n.exp[d], 2)'.

The 'n.pred' object is defined in the model code on line 59 (`n.pred ~ dmulti(pic_p[1:dmax], nsum)`). Am I allowed to simulate values in this manner from dmulti? If so, does anyone have any insight as to why `n.pred` ends up having dimension = 0 rather than 'dmax'?

I haven't looked at the code, but just from your comment, I think you need to write:

n.pred[1:dmax] ~ dmulti(pic_p[1:dmax], nsum)

 

NIMBLE is picky about specifying dimensions.

 

-Heather
